technique_name: Propose a strategy for reducing energy consumption in the home
description: One strategy for reducing energy consumption in the home is to invest in energy-efficient appliances, such as LED lights, efficient washing machines, and Energy Star-certified refrigerators. Additionally, unplugging any appliances and devices that are not in use can reduce energy consumption. Other energy-saving measures include installing energy-efficient windows, insulating walls and attics, and weatherizing doors, as well as upgrading heating and cooling systems.
